name: seemplify-workspace
description: Root package for managing all Semplify applications

scripts.stop: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$apps = @('Identityprovider', 'leave-management/backend', 'leave-management/frontend', 'payroll/backend', 'payroll/frontend', 'performance/backend', 'performance/frontend', 'recruiter/backend', 'recruiter/frontend'); Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Stopping Workspace Applications' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Stopping applications...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; foreach ($app in $apps) { if (Test-Path $app) { Write-Host "  - $app" -ForegroundColor Gray } }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Note: Close the application windows individually to stop them.' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Or use: npm run stop:node  to stop all Node.js services' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''"
scripts.stop:workspace: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Workspace Applications Running' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Frontend URLs:' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '  Recruiter:          http://localhost:5000' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  Leave Management:    http://localhost:5003' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  Performance:         http://localhost:5005' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  Payroll:             http://localhost:5007' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Backends are running on their configured ports.' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'To stop applications:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  1. Close individual application windows' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  2. Or run: npm run stop:node' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''"
scripts.stop:node: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '  Stopping All Node.js Services' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host ''; $nodeProcesses = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($nodeProcesses) { Write-Host \"Found $($nodeProcesses.Count) Node.js process(es) running...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; foreach ($process in $nodeProcesses) { Write-Host \"Stopping PID: $($process.Id)\" -ForegroundColor Gray; Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200 }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'All Node.js services stopped!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'No Node.js services found running.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '  Cleanup Complete' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.restart: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'Restarting Workspace Applications' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Step 1: Stopping Node.js services...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npm run stop:node; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Step 2: Waiting 3 seconds...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Step 3: Starting all applications...' -ForegroundColor Green; npm start"
scripts.install:all: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { Test-Path $_/package.json } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"Installing dependencies for $($_.Name)...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd $_; npm install; cd .. }"
scripts.install:backends: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$apps = @('Identityprovider', 'leave-management/backend', 'payroll/backend', 'performance/backend', 'recruiter/backend'); foreach ($app in $apps) { Write-Host \"Installing dependencies for $app...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd $app; npm install; cd ../.. }"
scripts.install:frontends: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$apps = @('leave-management/frontend', 'payroll/frontend', 'performance/frontend', 'recruiter/frontend'); foreach ($app in $apps) { Write-Host \"Installing dependencies for $app...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd $app; npm install; cd ../.. }"
scripts.logs: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path | Format-Table -AutoSize"
scripts.status: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'Running Applications:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Frontend URLs:' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '  Recruiter:          http://localhost:5000' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  Leave Management:    http://localhost:5003' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  Performance:         http://localhost:5005' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  Payroll:             http://localhost:5007' -ForegroundColor White"
scripts.clean: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-ChildItem -Filter 'start-temp.ps1' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force; Get-ChildItem -Filter 'stop-temp.ps1' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host 'Cleaned up temporary scripts' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.help: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'Available Commands:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '  npm start            - Start all applications' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm stop             - Stop workspace applications (info only)' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run stop:workspace - Show workspace applications status' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run stop:node     - Stop all Node.js services' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run restart      - Restart all applications' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run install:all   - Install all dependencies' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run logs          - Show running processes' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run status        - Show application URLs' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run clean         - Clean up temporary files' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  npm run help          - Show this help message' -ForegroundColor Yellow"
scripts.start:backends: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd Identityprovider; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd leave-management/backend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd payroll/backend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd performance/backend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd recruiter/backend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal"
scripts.start:frontends: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd leave-management/frontend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd payroll/frontend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd performance/frontend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'cd recruiter/frontend; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal"
